facts.business: Maan Aluminium Limited is one of India's largest manufacturers and exporters of aluminum extruded products with an installed capacity of 24,000 MTs per annum, offering custom-made profiles for diverse sectors including construction, automobile, solar, defense, railway, and electrical.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Commissioned, capacity increased from 10,000 to 24,000 TPA
Ongoing, partially spent in last few years

guidance_or_targets.statement: Commercializing new plant capacity, widening custom-fabricated product basket, and expanding into newer domestic geographic territories
guidance_or_targets.value: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue surged to ₹230 crore (up from ₹200 crore in Q1 FY26)

auditor.name: M/s. Khandelwal & Khandelwal Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Capitalisation of Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE) due to significant capital expenditure and management judgement in applying Ind AS 16

key_risks: Judgement in capitalisation of PPE per Ind AS 16
facts.related_party_note: Exclusive distributor for Hindalco Industries across North and South India; raw material sourcing from Vedanta Aluminium and NALCO
